answer: Make reputation non-transferable and slow to grow: each new identity must post a bond that vests only after it grades peers consistently with consensus over many epochs. A sybil farm then needs a separate bond per fake, and its votes cluster suspiciously, so graders trace each thread of correlated scores back to one funder and slash it. A thousand puppets is a fable once every plume of fresh accounts costs real, locked capital and leaves a statistical fingerprint.
